title: Aligning to What? Limits to RLHF Based Alignment
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the association of the personality trait 'religious' with speakers of African American English (AAE) versus Standard American English (SAE) as part of a broader study on racial and dialectal biases.
findings: The personality trait 'religious' was included as one of many attributes in a study on racial and dialectal biases. However, the paper does not report any specific findings for this particular trait, focusing instead on overall trends in bias.
